rationale: Violent attack by Ukrainian in neighboring Poland raises regional security concerns and may affect Romanian attitudes toward Ukrainian refugees; sabotage on Polish infrastructure supporting Ukraine also relevant.

top_events.title: Priest killed and four injured in knife attack at Polish abbey
top_events.label: Ukrainian suspect kills priest in Poland

top_events.summary: Polish government confirms sabotage at satellite station providing internet to Ukraine. Continues pattern of hybrid warfare in the region, raising security concerns for all eastern EU members.
